display_title: My Lady Only Gives Me White Rice
description:
*An Oriental coming-of-age romance about the secret affair between the Seongga madam, Yun So-Hui, and her slave, Deok-Bong.*

Yun So-Hui, the madam of the Seongga, lives a chaste life in memory of her deceased husband. Although she received a virtuous epitaph from the king, So-Hui secretly lusts after her slave, Deok-Bong. One day, while soothing herself alone, thinking of Deok-Bong, she is caught by Deok-Bong, who comes to visit her. 

*"Have you been looking at this slave like this all along?"* 

But Deok-Bong, as if he had been waiting, is eyeing So-Hui with a penchant for her...

(Source: Ridibooks, translated)
